| [AstroLumina-AstrologyAPI](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-AstrologyAPI) | Chart engine API: natal / predictive / synastry computations, timezone resolution, translation catalogs, Prometheus metrics |
| [AstroLumina-BookingAPI](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-BookingAPI) | Sessions & seats API: availability, Cal.com wiring, R2/D1 storage, booking emails |
| [AstroLumina-PaymentAPI](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-PaymentAPI) | Stripe API: products, prices, checkout & payment intents |

| [AstroLumina-Kubernetes](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Kubernetes) | Kustomize manifests per env: blue-green Deployments, live Services, Traefik IngressRoutes, HPA, NetworkPolicies, Doppler secrets |
| [AstroLumina-Helm](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Helm) | The `astrolumina` chart + per-env values: per-service live colors, pinned image tags, TLS & dashboard auth for production |
| [AstroLumina-ArgoCD](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-ArgoCD) | GitOps bootstrap: install RBAC, ApplicationSets for the K8s & Helm repos (manual sync), admin password rotation, CI |
| [AstroLumina-Monitoring](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Monitoring) | Observability values: kube-prometheus-stack config, per-env ServiceMonitors, dashboards & runbooks |

| Repository | What lives here |
|---|---|
| [AstroLumina-Terraform](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Terraform) | KVM/libvirt VMs for the RKE2 cluster (control-plane + workers), cloud-init with Tailscale onboarding, CI with fmt/validate/tflint/Trivy |
| [AstroLumina-Terraform-Library](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Terraform-Library) | Reusable Terraform modules only: KVM VM modules + the 15 AWS/Floci modules backing the AWS labs, versioned releases |
| [AstroLumina-AWS](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-AWS) | 15 hands-on AWS labs on the Floci local emulator (S3, DynamoDB, IAM, VPC, EC2, Lambda, RDS, ECS/Fargate, EKS, Route 53 & ALB, security baseline, Budgets), setup docs for Terraform + Floci + AWS CLI, plus a two-account IAM role assumption interview scenario |
| [AstroLumina-Ansible](https://github.com/AstroLumina-Rise-n-Shine/AstroLumina-Ansible) | RKE2 cluster configuration: prerequisites, server & agent roles, playbooks, CI with lint/syntax-check/shellcheck |
